metadata.title: Lesson 1: Interpreting a client request
metadata.summary: Learn how to read a client brief as a software developer: extract the problem, users, constraints and unknowns before proposing a solution.

metadata.title: Lesson 2: Defining project context
metadata.summary: Turn the brief into a project context statement covering organisation, users, environment, stakeholders and constraints.

metadata.title: Lesson 3: Market environment and existing systems
metadata.summary: Research the market environment, common problems, and the hardware and software already in use before evaluating new ideas.

metadata.title: Homework: Independent research into similar products
metadata.summary: Find two existing products used in adult learning or community booking and evaluate how far they fit Oakridge Skills Hub.

metadata.title: Lesson 1: Evaluating existing and potential solutions
metadata.summary: Judge candidate solutions against the Oakridge problem, users, constraints and existing systems from Week 1.

metadata.title: Lesson 2: Emerging technologies in this context
metadata.summary: Investigate which emerging technologies could matter for Oakridge, and which are distractions at this stage.

metadata.title: Lesson 3: Regulations, guidelines and knowledge gaps
metadata.summary: Identify situational regulations and your own knowledge, skill and capability gaps before Week 3 requirements work.

metadata.title: Homework: Evidence log for solutions and gaps
metadata.summary: Complete a short evidence log that Week 3 can use when defining business requirements and scope.
